lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly ordered series of circular high-luminance points arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows along the longitudinal axes, specifically visible posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal ridges, forming a grid-like pattern where high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct vertical luminance gradient from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette, showing less regular spacing compared to the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Large cluster of smaller biological entities (schooling fish) positioned ventrally and partially occluding the lower pectoral region and ventral-lateral flank.
